top1.title: 【2026-11-19】Google検索のAI Mode、一時的な会話機能を世界展開
top1.lead1: Googleは検索のAI Modeに、検索履歴や将来のパーソナライズに反映されない一時的な会話機能を導入する。
top1.lead2: 設定変更は不要で、専用アイコンから利用できる。デスクトップとモバイルの対応する全言語で順次展開する。

top10.title: [2026-11-19] Google Search rolls out temporary conversations in AI Mode worldwide
top10.summary: Google has introduced temporary conversations in AI Mode. These conversations will not be reflected in search history or future personalization, and the feature is rolling out gradually in all supported languages.

top10.title: [2026-11-19] Major US banks explicitly assign customers responsibility for account activity by external AI agents
top10.summary: Citi has changed its terms to explicitly state that customers are responsible for transactions made by external AI and losses following the exposure of authentication credentials. Similar moves have been reported at PNC and Citizens.

top10.title: [2026-11-19] Altman opposes handing decision-making authority to AI
top10.summary: OpenAI's Altman said at the DealBook Summit that humans should retain control over the future. Brockman discussed challenges in technologies for monitoring advanced AI.

top10.title: [2026-11-19] Analysis: Semiconductor demand grows despite concerns over a slowdown in frontier AI development
top10.summary: The Verge analyzed Nvidia's and AMD's financial performance and demand for inference. It explained that the effects of a development slowdown would take time to emerge and that competition with specialized chips is also important.

top10.title: [2026-11-19] Snapchat announces CLI for creating AR lenses from Claude Code and Cursor
top10.summary: Snapchat has announced Easy Lens CLI. It allows users to create AR lenses using natural language from tools including Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, and proceed through previewing and publishing.

top10.title: [2026-11-19] Disney unveils prototype Star Wars robot that responds to visitors using AWS AI
top10.summary: Disney has unveiled an animatronic prototype that responds to visitors using AI running on AWS. Its movements and dialogue are created in advance, and the AI selects among them.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
editorsDesk.bonusNote: 今日のおまけアニメ。クリックで再生。
